editionLabel: Renegade English rulebook, 2023 copyright, with solo mode
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently took out the garbage goes first. If nobody has done so, the rulebook suggests racing to the nearest bin to take out the garbage. Continue clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: This opening rule applies to multiplayer play. In solo mode, one person controls the fleet and may activate any of their ships on each turn.
